title: Canonical open-extension scalar-restriction comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be finite commutative rings in universe $u$, let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism, and let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion of schemes in universe $u$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use the ordinary constant-ring module sheaves and uncompleted unbounded derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $\varphi_W:A_W\to B_W$ for the canonical constant coefficient sheaf map [def-sp-proetale-constant-coefficient-ring-map], $r_W$ for scalar restriction along it [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and $J_R=j_{!,R}$ for sheafified extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Define $a^0:J_A r_U\xrightarrow{\sim}r_Z J_B$ by transporting the fixed-scalar comparison through the canonical module realization equivalences used in $J_R$. The fixed-scalar comparison is the left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism between scalar restriction followed by open extension and open extension followed by scalar restriction, after identifying their common right adjoint (open restriction followed by scalar coextension). The realization comparisons are the identity on sheafified underlying abelian presheaves and preserve constant scalar sections. Thus this is the canonical comparison induced by the identity of extension presheaves with the restricted scalar action, not an arbitrary isomorphism. Define $a:J_A r_U\xrightarrow{\sim}r_Z J_B$ on the entire unbounded derived categories by exact termwise localization of $a^0$, with the canonical localization comparisons for the two composite functors [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. These are the published definitions sfOpenRestriction and sfOpenRestrictionDerived; no coefficient cocycle or normalization theorem conclusion is included.

def sfOpenRestrictionDerived {U Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (φ : A →+* B) :
    (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars U φ).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j A).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j B).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z φ).mapDerivedCategory
